scope: One freshly generated seed-47 common ALNS incumbent, two sequential matched-input matched-incumbent 660s capacity-dual-repair profiles; not two independently randomized cold starts or stability evidence.
hypothesis: For the same full-domain pricing reports, reduce subset and delivery-count multipliers and task prices via sufficient mandatory-task inequalities; use a small correction LP within the remaining deadline. Whole-profile same-budget certificates may improve without changing routing models.
default: Capacity repair disabled. Count repair disabled. column_generation unchanged.
validation_method: Original complete pricing matrix and raw bound replay; original capacity RHS rebuilt independently; repaired prices checked via all mandatory-task sufficient inequalities and independent price-maximization LP; whole cycle and full-master projection.
limits: One seed, sequential timed pipelines sharing a fresh initial; no population stability or isolated primal effect claimed.
adoption: Not adopted as default. Fixed-witness capacity repair gains did not translate to a better timed pipeline. Retained experimental option and original negative results.
